sentences.text:
2024 
Author: Soumen Sen Bench: Soumen Sen 10.07.2024

In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under section 438 of the Code  Criminal Procedure in connection with Tehatta Police Station Case No. 360   2024 dated 17.05.2024 corresponding to S.L No. 1030 of 2024 under Sections  498a/325/307/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code read with Sections 3/4 of the  Dowry Prohibition Act.
 And  In Re: Bholanath Biswas  Petitioner  Mr. Asraf Mondal  Ms. Debjani Roy Choudhuri For the Petitioner  Mr. Rana Mukherjee  Mr. Ashok Das For the State  Mr. A.P Roy  Syed Murshid Alam  Sk. Nowajuddin  Mr. Subrata Ghosh  Ms. Amrita Sen  Mr. Nobiul Islam For the De-facto Complainant  1.
Heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties.
2. Considering the materials available in the case diary, the statement of the victim as well as the neighbours directly implicating the petitioner in the commission of the alleged offence, we are not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
3. Accordingly, the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner is rejected and the same is accordingly disposed of.
